name: Loving Someone
overview: Scripture reveals that loving someone is rooted in the selfless, steadfast love God has shown through the gift of His Son, calling believers to love one another as Christ loved us (John 3:16; John 15:12). This love creates a strong, unbreakable bond like a threefold cord, offering strength and support in times of trial (Ecclesiastes 4:12). Furthermore, God's presence and help provide assurance and courage, enabling believers to love without fear or discouragement (Isaiah 41:10). True love also calls us to recognize the spiritual bondage of sin and the freedom found in Christ, underscoring the transformative power of divine love in human relationships (John 8:34).
